Summary: Horizon Response Systems is a 1,200-employee CCaaS vendor that provides omnichannel routing and agent desktops to large retailers. They run ~4k concurrent agents during peak season; concern is tail-latency and graceful degradation. Interested in real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions + pop-up tool calls) and automated ticket summarization for triage.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (Avery Chen) — business problem: reduce AHT by 20% and ramp new agents faster.
- 2026-01-18: Platform demo (SE: Lena Ortiz) — showed streaming suggestions prototype using hosted model; client requested lower P50/P95 for first-token latency.

Technical requirements / constraints (CRM-style fragments):
- Streaming suggestions must appear in <150ms for token streaming on 90th pct; ideal target <100ms 90th for proactive completions.
- Throughput: support 2k concurrent agent sessions in NA region during pilot; spike handling for 6k+ during promotions.
- Prefers model variants with strong reranking for suggested answers and strict tool-call gating.
- Must integrate with existing agent desktop via lightweight websocket + function/tool-calling hooks to retrieve CRM fields and run account lookups.
- Data handling: transcripts retained per region rules; EU data must stay in customer VPC or on-prem.
- Guardrails: deterministic deny list + context-aware hallucination detection; human-in-the-loop escalation route.
- Auditability: token-level audit trail, immutable event logs for every suggestion/tool call.

Business/POC success criteria (short):
- 18-22% reduction in average handle time on tested queues.
- Suggestion precision > 85% (human-verified sample).
- No security exceptions in pen-test / network review.
